name: curator
title: 信息维护者
description: 清理过期 bus/memory/datasets，去重，压缩，对抗熵增

spec.command: python3 -c "import yaml,os; [print(f) for f in os.listdir('/home/administrator/shared-skills/hermes-origin') if os.path.isdir(f'/home/administrator/shared-skills/hermes-origin/{f}')]"
python3 -c "import os,glob,time; stale=[f for f in glob.glob('/home/administrator/.hermes/logs/*.log') if time.time()-os.path.getmtime(f)>604800]; print(f'Stale logs: {len(stale)}')"

python3 -c "import sqlite3,os; db=sqlite3.connect('/home/administrator/.hermes/state/agent_core.db'); c=db.cursor(); c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE updated_at < ?', (time.time()-2592000,)); print(f'Old sessions: {c.fetchone()[0]}')"

output_targets: bus cat=skill_audit 报告损坏/过期 skill
bus cat=architecture 数据膨胀预警
eval_criteria: 验证: 每轮扫描所有 SKILL.md（~100个）完成 < 30秒
验证: 发现 YAML 语法错误 → 写 bus skill_audit 并附修复方案
验证: 发现 >7天无更新的 skill → 标记需评审
验证: 清理 >30天的 session 记录、过期日志 → 写 bus cleanup
验证: agent_core.db 膨胀 > 100MB → 写 bus architecture 预警
goal: 清理过期 bus/memory/datasets，去重，压缩，对抗熵增
constraints: 遵循 维护 角色红线
不做超出职责范围的事
